Name: Shemuel, Son of Ammihud
Summary: Shemuel, Son of Ammihud was the prince of Simeon appointed to divide the land of Canaan by inheritance among the tribes.
KeyStory: Shemuel was named by the LORD, with Eleazar and Joshua, to apportion the promised land to the nine and a half tribes.
LifeLesson: Dividing what God gives takes honest hands.
